'''Jhas''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]],<ref name="SB" /><ref name="GJ" /><ref name="EA" /> located on the fringe of the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], at the edge of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="UI">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031204hoth|text=Hoth: Under the Ice|int=Hoth: Under the Ice}}</ref> Jhas had twenty-eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and, along with [[Ordaj]], was one of the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="SB" /><ref name="GJ" /><ref name="EA" />

The Hoth system was a collection of barren worlds and whirling rocks, devoid of apparent wealth and marginally habitable only by the desperate.<ref name="EA" /> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Jhas had no known [[City/Legends|settlements]].<ref name="GJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], except [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], were introduced in the first part of the article series ''[[Hoth: Under the Ice]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on [[Wizards.com]] in [[2003]].<ref name="SB" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Hoth star system in grid square K-18.<ref name="EA" />
